airgapllm: Verifiably Offline Containerized Local LLM Workflows

Source: R/airgapllm-package.R
airgapllm-package.Rd

A privacy-first workbench for running reproducible, network-isolated local open-weights large language models (Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM) on sensitive human-subjects research text governed by IRB, HIPAA, and FERPA protocols.

Core Architectural Pillars

Air-Gapped Container Lifecycle, Hardware Sizing & Benchmarking

airgap_container_spec(), emit_docker_run(), emit_docker_compose(), emit_apptainer_def(), verify_model_digest(), is_loopback_endpoint(), preflight_isolation_check(), estimate_vram_requirements(), recommend_runtime_config(), and benchmark_local_runtime().

Pre-Inference Privacy, PII & k-Anonymity Engine

pii_default_entities(), hipaa_restricted_zip3(), pii_config(), pii_detect(), pii_redact(), pii_privacy_report(), pii_audit_dataframe(), pii_vault_key(), pii_pseudonymize(), pii_reidentify(), pii_vault_save(), pii_vault_load(), pii_vault_rotate_key(), assess_reidentification_risk(), and apply_k_anonymity().

Resumable Schema-Enforced & Consensus Batch Extractor

chunk_clinical_texts(), schema_field(), extraction_schema(), as_json_schema(), validate_extraction(), build_repair_prompt(), runtime_ollama(), runtime_openai_local(), runtime_mock(), airgap_extract(), airgap_extract_consensus(), consensus_passes(), consensus_diagnostics(), and extraction_manifest().

Immutable Audit Trail & IRB Protocol Generator

audit_log_append(), audit_log_read(), audit_log_verify(), generate_irb_narrative(), and export_irb_compliance_packet().
